boundary_decision.rationale: The subject composes multiple independently identifiable returns, schedules, declarations, submissions, acknowledgements, assessment notices, liabilities, allocations and disputes over one governed case. Aggregate is more accurate than event. The frozen record_plane world-model and catalogue entry_kind standalone-mm are separate axes from this subject-schema decision.

decisions.rationale: The aggregate owns only the bounded filing-and-assessment case. Taxpayer, registration, account, obligation, law, form and authority records remain external and are referenced with versions and roles.
Return, schedules and attachments preserve source records, data cut, computation, currency, units, rounding and reconciliation without absorbing ledger or evidence masters.
Schema, code-list, business-rule, signature, transmission, receipt, filing acceptance and processing outcomes remain independently attributable and timed.
Taxpayer positions and authority-determined values retain separate sources. Adjustments require provision, calculation, reason, notice, effective time and review-right context.
Payment, refund, penalty, interest and adjudication records remain external. The case owns typed allocations, disputed-item context, deadlines, stays and outcome references.

No relation-ledger edge is registered. Plausible links to taxpayer, obligation, document, evidence, payment, audit, assessment, dispute and records models remain candidate boundary notes and create no cascade behavior.

OECD material is comparative or advisory, IRS and HMRC are jurisdiction-specific, and EU instruments require current transposition and procedural context. No source is generalized into universal tax law.
MeF, HMRC VAT API, XBRL, UBL, XML Signature and PROV cover different filing, reporting, document, signature and provenance surfaces. Every mapping must pin version, scope and information loss.

One Claude Sonnet and one Grok 4.6 research attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex audited the frozen validated result and comparison locally without tools or new research facts. Confidence remains medium and assurance remains reviewable-draft.
